At the bottom I can make out only a vague rounded foot shape under the front of the body; a clear second foot is hard to find, but it may be tucked behind the body. Peach Peeplet in a white chef's hat, sitting right of the basket. Its arm toward the tray reaches out from the body toward the mug and the small mushroom, about half a body width or more. The tip blends into the area around the mug rather than ending in a clean round nub. The other arm is held against its chest. Its lower body does not show two separate stubby feet. Instead the bottom tapers off to the right into one melted, tail-like lobe on the blanket, so no two feet or legs can be told apart.

20261019_vista-morning-0_decoy-7-long-ar.limbs: Peeplet 1 (left on the blanket): sage-green body with a red, white-spotted mushroom cap. It is seated and round, with its face sitting straight on the body and no neck. Its left arm is a small rounded nub at its side, sticking out well under a quarter of the body width. Its right arm is a short rounded nub resting in front of its tummy beside a pale item. It is not stretched, not hand-like, and not merged into the item. Two small rounded feet show at the bottom front on the blanket, one each side. Two eyes. Peeplet 2 (right of the basket): peach body with a white chef's hat. It is seated and round, with no neck. One arm is a short rounded nub raised to hold a small cup close to its body, reaching well under half the body width. The tip is rounded, there are no fingers, and the arm stays distinct from the cup. The other arm is a small nub at its far side. Two short feet show at its base in front of it on the blanket. Two eyes. Both bodies are about 11-13% of the painting's height and sit in the right half of the painting. The scene is a wide morning landscape with a hill, a tree, a cottage with flower boxes, a basket of fruit, a teapot, a striped mug and a tray. There is no text and no human figure.

20261019_vista-night-0.jpg.limbs: Morning painting: two Peeplets. 1) A sage-green Peeplet with a red, white-spotted mushroom cap, seated on the left edge of the picnic blanket. 2) A peach/pink Peeplet with a white chef's toque, seated on the right of the blanket beside the basket. Its left arm is a short round-tipped nub reaching towards the small mushroom cup, sticking out roughly a quarter to a third of the body width. It is not flared or hand-like and has no fingers. Its right arm is a small nub at the right side. Seated, it shows two stubby feet in front. No extra, fused or missing limbs were found.

20261019_vista-night-0_decoy-2-missing-l.limbs: Morning painting: two Peeplets on the picnic blanket, a green one wearing a red white-spotted mushroom cap on the left of the basket and a peach one wearing a white chef's hat on the right.
